source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice mcqs written from Chapter 21 (PDF 75-87), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 21 (Halogenoalkanes) ke poore chapter se practice MCQs hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein. Har sawal ka aik sahi jawab hai aur saath mukhtasar wajah; numerical sawalon mein hal ke qadam diye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
1 In the past, chlorofluorocarbons (CFCs) were mainly used as:
(Maazi mein chlorofluorocarbons (CFCs) zyada tar kis kaam aate thay?)
blocks.explanation: CFCs refrigerants (thanda karne wale) aur aerosol propellants ke tor par istemal hote thay; ab inhein badla ja raha hai.

book_ref.quote: chlorofluorocarbons (CFCs) were used as refrigerants and aerosol propellants

blocks.prompt:
2 CFCs are being replaced by compounds that contain no chlorine, such as:
(CFCs ko aise compounds se badla ja raha hai jin mein chlorine nahi hoti, maslan:)
blocks.explanation: Freons khud CFCs hain (Freon-12 = CCl₂F₂); in ki jagah HFCs aa rahe hain jin mein chlorine nahi hoti (Book correction).

book_ref.quote: CFCs are being replaced by compounds such as hydrofluorocarbons (HFCs)

blocks.prompt:
3 Freon-12, a chlorofluorocarbon, has the formula:
(Freon-12, jo aik chlorofluorocarbon hai, ka formula kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Freon CFCs ka tijarati naam hai; Freon-12 CCl₂F₂ hai (Book correction).

book_ref.quote: for example Freon-12 is CCl₂F₂

blocks.prompt:
4 The halogen-containing polymer used for non-stick cookware is:
(Non-stick bartanon ke liye istemal hone wala halogen wala polymer kaun sa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Halogenoalkanes polymers ke intermediates hain, jaise piping ke liye PVC aur non-stick bartanon ke liye PTFE (Teflon).

book_ref.quote: PTFE (Teflon) for non-stick cookware

blocks.prompt:
5 PVC (polyvinyl chloride), made from halogenated intermediates, is used mainly for:
(PVC (polyvinyl chloride) zyada tar kis kaam aata hai?)
blocks.explanation: PVC piping (paaip) ke liye aur PTFE non-stick bartanon ke liye istemal hota hai.

book_ref.quote: PVC (polyvinyl chloride) for piping

blocks.prompt:
6 Halothane is widely used as:
(Halothane zyada tar kis tor par istemal hota hai?)

options.text: inhalation anesthetic (saans wali behoshi ki dawa)

blocks.explanation: Halothane taaqatwar inhalation anesthetic (saans se di jane wali behoshi ki dawa) hai jo surgery mein waqti behoshi laata hai.

book_ref.quote: Halothane is a halogenated hydrocarbon widely used

blocks.prompt:
7 The halogen atoms present in a halothane molecule (CF₃–CHClBr) are:
(Halothane molecule (CF₃–CHClBr) mein kaun se halogen atoms hain?)
blocks.explanation: Halothane mein aik carbon par teen F hain jo doosre carbon se jura hai jis par Cl, H aur Br hain.

book_ref.quote: It induces a reversible loss of consciousness during surgeries

blocks.prompt:
8 Chloroform and other chlorinated anesthetics are now banned because of:
(Chloroform aur doosri chlorinated anesthetics ab kyun mamnoo hain?)
blocks.explanation: Chloroform aur doosri chlorinated anesthetics zehreelay pan (toxicity) aur hifazati khadshat ki wajah se mamnoo hain.

book_ref.quote: which are banned now due to their toxicity and safety concerns

blocks.prompt:
9 A halogenoalkane is formed when, in an alkane:
(Halogenoalkane tab banta hai jab alkane mein:)

options.text: aik ya zyada carbon atoms halogen se badal jayein
sirf double bond par halogen molecule jure
aik ya zyada hydrogen atoms halogen atoms se badal jayein

blocks.explanation: Jab alkane ke aik ya zyada H atoms halogen atoms se badal diye jayein to halogenoalkane banta hai.

book_ref.quote: is formed when one or more hydrogen atoms of an alkane are replaced by halogen atoms

blocks.prompt:
10 Dichloromethane, CH₂Cl₂, is classified as a:
(Dichloromethane, CH₂Cl₂, kis qisam mein aata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Halogen atoms ki tadaad ke mutabiq mono, di, tri ya poly halogenoalkanes hote hain; CH₂Cl₂ mein do hain.

book_ref.quote: depending upon the number of halogen atoms

blocks.prompt:
11 Monohalogenoalkanes are also called:
(Monohalogenoalkanes ko aur kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Monohalogenoalkanes ko alkyl halides bhi kehte hain, general formula R – X.

book_ref.quote: monohalogenoalkanes are also called alkyl halides

blocks.prompt:
12 In the general formula R – X of alkyl halides, X stands for:
(Alkyl halides ke general formula R – X mein X kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: R methyl, ethyl, propyl waghaira ho sakta hai aur X halogen atom (F, Cl, Br, I) hai.

book_ref.quote: where R may be methyl, ethyl, propyl, etc., and X represents halogen atoms

blocks.prompt:
13 Monohalogenoalkanes are classified as primary, secondary and tertiary on the basis of:
(Monohalogenoalkanes ko primary, secondary aur tertiary mein kis bunyad par taqseem kiya jata hai?)

options.text: halogen wale carbon atom ki qisam

blocks.explanation: Yeh taqseem us carbon atom ki qisam par hai jis par halogen laga ho.

book_ref.quote: depending upon the type of carbon atom bearing the halogen atom

blocks.prompt:
14 Chloromethane, CH₃Cl, is a primary halogenoalkane because its halogen-bearing carbon is attached to:
(Chloromethane, CH₃Cl, primary halogenoalkane kyun hai? Is ka halogen wala carbon kitne carbon atoms se jura hai?)

options.text: aik halogen aur do carbon atoms se

blocks.explanation: Primary halogenoalkane mein C–X wala carbon aik ya kisi carbon se nahi jura hota; CH₃Cl mein kisi se nahi.

book_ref.quote: the halogen atom is attached with a carbon which is further attached to one or no carbon atom

blocks.prompt:
15 Which of these is a primary halogenoalkane?
(In mein se kaun sa primary halogenoalkane hai?)
blocks.explanation: 1-chloropropane mein C–Cl wala carbon sirf aik carbon se jura hai, is liye primary hai.

book_ref.quote: Examples of primary halogenoalkanes

blocks.prompt:
16 2-Chlorobutane, CH₃–CHCl–CH₂–CH₃, is a:
(2-Chlorobutane, CH₃–CHCl–CH₂–CH₃, kis qisam ka hai?)
blocks.explanation: Is ka C–Cl wala carbon seedha do carbon atoms se jura hai, is liye secondary hai.

book_ref.quote: Examples of secondary halogenoalkanes

blocks.prompt:
17 2-Chloro-2-methylpropane, (CH₃)₃C–Cl, is tertiary because the carbon bearing Cl is attached directly to:
(2-Chloro-2-methylpropane, (CH₃)₃C–Cl, tertiary kyun hai? Cl wala carbon seedha kitne carbon atoms se jura hai?)
blocks.explanation: Tertiary halogenoalkane mein halogen wala carbon seedha teen carbon atoms se jura hota hai.

book_ref.quote: the halogen atom is attached to a carbon atom which is further attached to three carbon atoms directly

blocks.prompt:
18 Ethane reacts with chlorine in the presence of light to give:
(Ethane roshni ki maujoodgi mein chlorine se react karke kya deta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Roshni mein alkane ki halogenation: CH₃–CH₃ + Cl₂ → CH₃–CH₂–Cl + HCl (21.1).

book_ref.quote: Halogenoalkanes can be prepared by the halogenation of alkanes in the presence of light

blocks.prompt:
19 The reaction H₂C=CH₂ + HBr → CH₃–CH₂–Br is an example of:
(Reaction H₂C=CH₂ + HBr → CH₃–CH₂–Br kis qisam ki misaal hai?)
blocks.explanation: Alkenes par hydrogen halides ki electrophilic addition se halogenoalkanes bante hain; ethene se bromoethane (21.1).

book_ref.quote: electrophilic addition of hydrogen halides to alkenes

blocks.prompt:
20 In the conversion CH₃–CH₂–OH + HCl → CH₃–CH₂–Cl + H₂O, ZnCl₂ acts as:
(CH₃–CH₂–OH + HCl → CH₃–CH₂–Cl + H₂O mein ZnCl₂ ka kya kirdar hai?)
blocks.explanation: Alcohols halogen acid se alkyl halides banate hain; ZnCl₂ catalyst (raftar barhane wala) hai (21.1).

book_ref.quote: in the presence of ZnCl₂ which acts as a catalyst

blocks.prompt:
21 When ethanol reacts with thionyl chloride, the catalyst used is:
(Ethanol jab thionyl chloride se react kare to catalyst kaun sa hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Alcohols pyridine catalyst ki maujoodgi mein thionyl chloride se alkyl chlorides dete hain (21.1).

book_ref.quote: react with thionyl chloride in pyridine as a catalyst to give alkyl chlorides

blocks.prompt:
22 The thionyl chloride method of making chloroalkanes is especially useful because:
(Chloroalkanes banane ka thionyl chloride tareeqa khaas tor par mufeed kyun hai?)

options.text: by-products HCl aur SO₂ gases hain jo nikal jati hain aur khalis product bachta hai
sirf iodides ke saath chalta hai

blocks.explanation: CH₃CH₂OH + SOCl₂ → CH₃CH₂Cl + SO₂ + HCl; gas by-products ur jate hain aur khalis product reh jata hai (21.1).

book_ref.quote: the by-products (HCl and SO₂) are gases which go off leaving behind the pure product

blocks.prompt:
23 Ethanol reacts with PBr₃ to give bromoethane and:
(Ethanol PBr₃ se react karke bromoethane aur kya deta hai?)
blocks.explanation: 3CH₃CH₂OH + PBr₃ → 3CH₃CH₂Br + H₃PO₃ (21.1).

book_ref.quote: Phosphorus trihalides or phosphorus pentahalides react with alcohols

blocks.prompt:
24 How many moles of ethanol react with one mole of PBr₃?
(Aik mole PBr₃ ke saath ethanol ke kitne moles react karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: 3CH₃CH₂OH + PBr₃ → 3CH₃CH₂Br + H₃PO₃: aik PBr₃ ke teen Br teen –OH groups ki jagah lete hain (21.1).

book_ref.quote: react with alcohols to replace – OH group by a halo group

blocks.prompt:
25 The products of the reaction of ethanol with PCl₅ are:
(Ethanol aur PCl₅ ke reaction ke products kya hain?)
blocks.explanation: CH₃CH₂OH + PCl₅ → CH₃CH₂Cl + POCl₃ + HCl (21.1).

book_ref.quote: Phosphorus trihalides or phosphorus pentahalides react with alcohols

blocks.prompt:
26 When an alcohol is heated with KBr and H₂SO₄, the species that actually converts the alcohol into a bromoalkane is:
(Jab alcohol ko KBr aur H₂SO₄ ke saath garam karein to asal mein kaun sa maadda alcohol ko bromoalkane banata hai?)

options.text: KBr aur acid se bana HBr

blocks.explanation: Acid pehle KBr se HBr banata hai, phir HBr alcohol se react karke bromoalkane deta hai (21.1).

book_ref.quote: The acid first reacts with potassium bromide to give hydrogen bromide

blocks.prompt:
27 Besides bromoethane, the products of CH₃CH₂OH + KBr + H₂SO₄ are:
(CH₃CH₂OH + KBr + H₂SO₄ mein bromoethane ke ilawa products kya hain?)
blocks.explanation: CH₃CH₂OH + KBr + H₂SO₄ → CH₃CH₂Br + H₂O + KHSO₄ (21.1).

book_ref.quote: This method is commonly used to prepare bromoalkanes and iodoalkanes

blocks.prompt:
28 Phosphoric acid rather than sulphuric acid is preferred for preparing iodoalkanes because phosphoric acid:
(Iodoalkanes banane ke liye sulphuric acid ke bajaye phosphoric acid kyun behtar hai?)

options.text: alcohols se sirf alkenes deta hai
kamzor oxidizing agent hai, I⁻ ko I₂ mein kam badalta hai

blocks.explanation: Phosphoric acid kamzor oxidizing agent hai, is liye iodide ions ko iodine mein kam badalta hai (21.1).

book_ref.quote: less likely to oxidize iodide ions to iodine

blocks.prompt:
29 The organobromine compound mainly given off by marine algae and phytoplankton, carrying bromine into the stratosphere, is:
(Samundari algae aur phytoplankton zyada tar kaun sa organobromine compound kharij karte hain jo bromine ko stratosphere tak le jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Kitab ke box mein bromoethane likha hai, lekin asal qudrati ikhraj bromomethane (CH₃Br) aur bromoform hai (Book correction).

book_ref.quote: is bromomethane (methyl bromide, CH₃Br), together with bromoform (CHBr₃)

blocks.prompt:
30 Experiments show that the main factor deciding the reactivity of halogenoalkanes is:
(Tajurbaat ke mutabiq halogenoalkanes ki reactivity ka sab se bara factor kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: C–X bond ki mazbooti asal factor hai; kamzor bond aasaani se tootta hai aur molecule zyada reactive hota hai (21.2).

book_ref.quote: the strength of carbon halogen bond is the main factor which decides the reactivity of haloalkanes

blocks.prompt:
31 In a halogenoalkane molecule R – X, the partial charges are:
(Halogenoalkane molecule R – X mein partial charges kis tarah hain?)

options.text: carbon par δ–, X par δ+
X aur carbon dono par δ+
X se jure carbon par δ+, X par δ–

blocks.explanation: R – X mein halogen se jure carbon par partial positive aur halogen par partial negative charge hota hai (21.2).

book_ref.quote: an alkyl group with a partial positive charge on the carbon atom attached to halogen atom

blocks.prompt:
32 According to Table 21.1, the strongest carbon–halogen bond is:
(Table 21.1 ke mutabiq sab se mazboot carbon–halogen bond kaun sa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Bond energies: C–F 467, C–Cl 346, C–Br 290, C–I 228 kJ/mol; C–F sab se mazboot hai (21.2).

book_ref.quote: Table 21.1 Bond energies of different C-X bonds

blocks.prompt:
33 Using Table 21.1, by how much is the C – Cl bond energy greater than the C – Br bond energy?
(Table 21.1 se, C – Cl bond energy C – Br se kitni zyada hai?)

book_ref.quote: Table 21.1 Bond energies of different C-X bonds

blocks.prompt:
34 From Table 21.1, the difference between the strongest and the weakest C – X bond energies is:
(Table 21.1 se sab se mazboot aur sab se kamzor C – X bond energies ka farq kitna hai?)
blocks.explanation: Sab se mazboot C–F 467, sab se kamzor C–I 228: 467 – 228 = 239 kJ/mol (21.2).

book_ref.quote: Table 21.1 Bond energies of different C-X bonds

blocks.prompt:
35 For the same alkyl group, the correct order of reactivity of halogenoalkanes based on C – X bond strength is:
(Aik hi alkyl group ke liye C – X bond ki mazbooti ki bunyad par halogenoalkanes ki reactivity ki sahi tarteeb kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Iodo compounds ke bonds sab se kamzor, is liye sab se reactive; fluoro sab se kam: R–I > R–Br > R–Cl > R–F (21.2).

book_ref.quote: iodo compounds (with the weakest bonds) would be the most reactive halogenoalkanes

blocks.prompt:
36 Under ordinary conditions, fluoroalkanes:
(Aam halaat mein fluoroalkanes:)

options.text: react nahi karte, kyun ke C – F bond bohat mazboot hai
sab se tez react karte hain
sirf SN1 se react karte hain

blocks.explanation: C – F bond itna mazboot hai ke fluoroalkanes aam halaat mein react nahi karte (21.2).

book_ref.quote: the C – F bond is so strong that fluoroalkanes do not react under ordinary conditions

blocks.prompt:
37 Besides bond strength, which of the following is NOT listed in the chapter as a factor affecting the reactivity of halogenoalkanes?
(Bond ki mazbooti ke ilawa, in mein se kaun sa factor chapter mein halogenoalkanes ki reactivity par asar wala nahi likha?)
blocks.explanation: Doosre factors bond polarity, steric hindrance (jagah ki rukawat) aur inductive effect hain (21.2).

book_ref.quote: Some other factors which may affect the reactivity of halogenoalkanes are, bond polarity, steric hindrance, inductive effect

blocks.prompt:
38 The C – X bond in halogenoalkanes is polar because:
(Halogenoalkanes mein C – X bond polar kyun hai?)

options.text: carbon aur halogen ki electronegativity mukhtalif hai
halogen par koi lone pair nahi

blocks.explanation: C-X bond polar hai kyun ke C aur halogen ki electronegativity mein farq hai (21.3).

book_ref.quote: is polar due to the difference of electronegativity between C and the halogen atom

blocks.prompt:
39 In a halogenoalkane, the carbon of the C – X bond behaves as:
(Halogenoalkane mein C – X bond ka carbon kya kirdar ada karta hai?)

options.text: nucleophilic centre jis par electrophile hamla kare
electrophilic centre jis par nucleophile hamla kare

blocks.explanation: C-X ka carbon electrophilic centre hai jis par nucleophile hamla karta hai (21.3).

book_ref.quote: acts as an electrophilic centre, which can be attacked by a nucleophile

blocks.prompt:
40 Elimination (E) reactions of halogenoalkanes involve:
(Halogenoalkanes ke elimination (E) reactions mein kya hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Elimination mein halogenoalkane se HX nikalta hai aur alkene banti hai (21.3).

book_ref.quote: involve the removal of HX from halogenoalkanes

blocks.prompt:
41 In a nucleophilic substitution (SN) reaction of a halogenoalkane:
(Halogenoalkane ke nucleophilic substitution (SN) reaction mein:)

options.text: HX nikal kar alkene banti hai
hydrogen ki jagah halogen aata hai
halogen ki jagah koi aur atom ya group aata hai
halide ke do molecules jur jate hain

blocks.explanation: SN reactions mein halogen ki jagah koi aur atom ya group aa jata hai; halogen X⁻ ban kar nikalta hai (21.3).

book_ref.quote: Those reactions in which the halogen is replaced by some other atom or a group

blocks.prompt:
42 In the general SN reaction Nu⁻ + R–X → R–Nu + X⁻, the species X⁻ is called the:
(Aam SN reaction Nu⁻ + R–X → R–Nu + X⁻ mein X⁻ ko kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Drawing mein Nu⁻ attacking nucleophile, R–X substrate, R–Nu substituted product aur X⁻ leaving group hai (21.3).

book_ref.quote: Nucleophilic substitution reaction (original drawing

blocks.prompt:
43 The two main processes in nucleophilic substitution on alkyl halides are:
(Alkyl halides par nucleophilic substitution ke do bare processes kaun se hain?)

options.text: C – X bond tootna aur C – Nu bond banna
C=C bond banna aur HX nikalna
C – H tootna aur C – X banna

blocks.explanation: Leaving group ka nikalna (C – X bond tootna) aur nucleophile ka hamla (C – Nu bond banna) (21.3.1).

book_ref.quote: the departure of leaving group (breaking of C – X bond) and the attack of nucleophile

blocks.prompt:
44 If the breaking of the C – X bond and the formation of the C – Nu bond occur simultaneously in a single step, the mechanism is:
(Agar C – X bond ka tootna aur C – Nu bond ka banna aik hi qadam mein saath saath ho to mechanism kaun sa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Aik qadam mein saath saath tootna aur banna SN2 hai; do qadam mein ho to SN1 (21.3.1).

book_ref.quote: If the two processes occur simultaneously in single step the mechanism is called SN2

blocks.prompt:
45 In the SN2 mechanism, the extent of bond formation is:
(SN2 mechanism mein bond banne ki had kitni hoti hai?)

options.text: bond tootne ki had ke barabar

blocks.explanation: Jaise hi nucleophile hamla shuru kare, C – X bond tootna shuru hota hai; banne ki had tootne ki had ke barabar hai (21.3.1).

book_ref.quote: the extent of bond formation is equal to the extent of bond breaking

blocks.prompt:
46 In the SN2 mechanism, the nucleophile attacks the electrophilic carbon:
(SN2 mechanism mein nucleophile electrophilic carbon par kis taraf se hamla karta hai?)

options.text: leaving group ke jane ke baad
leaving group ke mukhalif taraf se

blocks.explanation: Nucleophile leaving group ke mukhalif taraf se hamla karta hai (peechhe se hamla) (21.3.1).

book_ref.quote: It attacks from the side which is opposite to the leaving group

blocks.prompt:
47 SN2 is called bimolecular because:
(SN2 ko bimolecular kyun kehte hain?)

options.text: is ke aik hi rate-determining step mein do molecules hissa lete hain

blocks.explanation: Reaction aik qadam mein hota hai jo rate-determining step hai aur is mein do molecules hissa lete hain (21.3.1).

book_ref.quote: two molecules are participating in this step, it is a bimolecular reaction

blocks.prompt:
48 The rate equation of an SN2 reaction is:
(SN2 reaction ki rate equation kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: SN2 ki raftar [alkyl halide] aur [nucleophile] dono par hai: Rate = k[RX]¹[Nu]¹ (21.3.1).

book_ref.quote: depend upon both the concentrations of alkyl halide and the attacking nucleophile

blocks.prompt:
49 The overall order of a typical SN2 reaction is:
(Aik aam SN2 reaction ka overall order kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Order = 1 + 1 = 2; aam SN2 reaction second order hai (21.3.1).

book_ref.quote: A typical SN2 reaction is a second order reaction

blocks.prompt:
50 For an SN2 reaction, the concentration of the alkyl halide is doubled and that of the nucleophile is tripled. The rate becomes:
(SN2 reaction mein alkyl halide ki concentration double aur nucleophile ki triple kar di jaye to rate kitna ho jayega?)
blocks.explanation: Rate = k[RX][Nu], is liye naya rate = 2 × 3 = 6 guna (21.3.1).

book_ref.quote: depend upon both the concentrations of alkyl halide and the attacking nucleophile

blocks.prompt:
51 For an SN2 reaction with k = 2.5 × 10⁻⁴ dm³ mol⁻¹ s⁻¹, [alkyl halide] = 0.10 mol dm⁻³ and [nucleophile] = 0.20 mol dm⁻³, the rate is:
(SN2 reaction mein k = 2.5 × 10⁻⁴ dm³ mol⁻¹ s⁻¹, [alkyl halide] = 0.10 mol dm⁻³ aur [nucleophile] = 0.20 mol dm⁻³ ho to rate kya hai?)

book_ref.quote: Mathematically, the rate can be expressed as:

blocks.prompt:
52 Which halogenoalkane always follows the SN2 mechanism when attacked by a nucleophile?
(Kaun sa halogenoalkane nucleophile ke hamle par hamesha SN2 mechanism follow karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Primary monohalogenoalkanes steric wajah se hamesha SN2 follow karte hain; bromoethane primary hai (21.3.1).

book_ref.quote: primary monohalogenoalkanes always follow SN2 mechanism whenever they are attacked by nucleophiles

blocks.prompt:
53 In a primary halogenoalkane the nucleophile can attack the electrophilic carbon easily because that carbon carries:
(Primary halogenoalkane mein nucleophile electrophilic carbon par aasaani se kyun hamla kar sakta hai? Us carbon par kya laga hota hai?)

options.text: sirf hydrogen atoms ya aik carbon atom

blocks.explanation: Primary mein substrate carbon par sirf H atoms ya aik carbon hota hai, is liye rukawat kam hai (21.3.1).

book_ref.quote: the nucleophile can approach and attack the electrophilic carbon easily

blocks.prompt:
54 In the SN2 reaction of bromomethane with hydroxide ion, the products are:
(Bromomethane aur hydroxide ion ke SN2 reaction ke products kya hain?)
blocks.explanation: OH⁻ CH₃–Br ke carbon par peechhe se hamla karta hai, transition state HO---C---Br se guzar kar CH₃OH + Br⁻ bante hain (21.3.1).

book_ref.quote: SN2 mechanism: bromomethane and hydroxide ion

blocks.prompt:
55 The first step of the SN1 mechanism is:
(SN1 mechanism ka pehla qadam kya hai?)

options.text: alkyl halide ki reversible ionization se carbocation banna
paanch groups wali transition state banna

blocks.explanation: Pehla qadam alkyl halide ki reversible ionization hai jis se carbocation intermediate banta hai (21.3.1).

book_ref.quote: The first step is the reversible ionization of the alkyl halide

blocks.prompt:
56 The ionization step of the SN1 mechanism takes place in the presence of:
(SN1 ka ionization step kis ki maujoodgi mein hota hai?)

options.text: aqueous acetone ya aqueous ethyl alcohol

blocks.explanation: Pehla qadam aqueous acetone ya aqueous ethyl alcohol mein alkyl halide ki reversible ionization hai (21.3.1).

book_ref.quote: in the presence of aqueous acetone or aqueous ethyl alcohol

blocks.prompt:
57 The intermediate formed in the SN1 mechanism is a:
(SN1 mechanism mein kaun sa intermediate banta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ionization step carbocation intermediate deta hai jis par phir nucleophile hamla karta hai (21.3.1).

book_ref.quote: This step provides a carbocation as an intermediate

blocks.prompt:
58 In the SN1 mechanism, the first step is the slow (rate-determining) step because:
(SN1 mechanism mein pehla qadam aahista (rate-determining) kyun hai?)

options.text: is mein do molecules takrate hain
is mein covalent bond tootta hai

blocks.explanation: Pehle qadam mein covalent bond tootta hai, is liye yeh doosre qadam (ions ka milna) se aahista hai (21.3.1).

book_ref.quote: so it is a slow step as compared to the second step

blocks.prompt:
59 SN1 is called unimolecular because:
(SN1 ko unimolecular kyun kehte hain?)

options.text: is ka sirf aik qadam hai
rate-determining step mein sirf aik molecule hissa leta hai
nucleophile slow step mein hissa leta hai

blocks.explanation: Rate-determining step mein sirf aik molecule (alkyl halide) hissa leta hai (21.3.1).

book_ref.quote: The mechanism is called unimolecular because only one molecule takes part in the rate-determining step

blocks.prompt:
60 For an SN1 reaction, the concentration of the nucleophile is doubled while that of the alkyl halide is kept the same. The rate:
(SN1 reaction mein nucleophile ki concentration double aur alkyl halide ki wohi rakhi jaye to rate:)
blocks.explanation: SN1 first order hai, Rate = k[alkyl halide]; nucleophile rate equation mein nahi (21.3.1).

book_ref.quote: the rates of such reactions depend only upon the concentration of the alkyl halide

blocks.prompt:
61 In an SN1 reaction, [alkyl halide] is tripled and [nucleophile] is halved. The new rate is:
(SN1 reaction mein [alkyl halide] triple aur [nucleophile] aadha kar diya jaye to naya rate kitna hai?)
blocks.explanation: Rate = k[alkyl halide], is liye rate 3 guna; nucleophile ki tabdeeli ka asar nahi (21.3.1).

book_ref.quote: Reactions involving SN1 mechanism show first order kinetics

blocks.prompt:
62 Tertiary monohalogenoalkanes always follow the SN1 mechanism mainly because:
(Tertiary monohalogenoalkanes hamesha SN1 kyun follow karte hain? Bari wajah:)
